text: The separate follow-up changes the final return from NS_OK to rv, which still holds GetServer’s result. Later formatting and display calls do not overwrite rv. The accepted inherited getter returns NS_OK when its output is non-null, while the pointer guard stops the null case before the final return. Under that checked base contract, the normal surviving path still returns NS_OK. This is not propagation of a localization or display result, and no compiler or runtime result was reproduced.
title: ProgressStatusString returns its server lookup result after the pointer guard
